items.query: What were the blockers raised in the Q1 planning meeting?
items.expected_answer: Three blockers were raised: (1) the mobile app is waiting on final UI designs from the design team (ETA January 22); (2) the database migration is blocked by the need for additional cloud storage budget approval; (3) the analytics pipeline depends on a third-party API that has not yet provided production access.

items.query: Who attended the Q1 planning meeting?
items.expected_answer: The attendees were Alice, Bob, Carol, and Dave.

items.query: What is the customer retention rate mentioned in the meeting notes?
items.expected_answer: Customer retention reached an all-time high of 94%.

items.query: What are the top engineering priorities for Q1?
items.expected_answer: The top engineering priorities are: (1) launch the new mobile app by February 15; (2) migrate the legacy database to PostgreSQL by March 1; (3) implement the new analytics pipeline.

items.query: List the action items from the Q1 planning meeting.
items.expected_answer: The action items are: (1) Alice to follow up with the design team for UI deliverables; (2) Bob to submit a budget request for cloud storage by January 18; (3) Carol to contact the third-party API provider and request production credentials.
